properties.note: IM ruling 3 (2026-10-27), c.1700: north limit = border of Ottoman Nubia at the Third Cataract / Hannik (GHA V ch.7 pp.174–175: frontier consolidated at Hannik c.1622, halfway between the Third Cataract and Mushu). Geometry unchanged: the claimed zone already stops at Old Dongola, south of Hannik (its northern lobe at ≈19.8N is the Abu Hamed Nile bend, not the Ottoman border); Hannik has no sourced coordinate, so the zone is not extended to it. Direct rule of the Abdallab (wad 'Adjib) to Hadjar al-'Asal, indirect to the Ottoman border (GHA V p.174): not split, Hadjar al-'Asal has no sourced coordinate. Shaykiyya independent from about the mid-17th century (GHA V p.174): not drawn separately, VERIFY. SPAULDING1985 registered but its text is not on the box; not consulted. Suakin stays Ottoman (outside this extent). Zones mode: a re-run of promote_drafts.py from db/border_drafts may overwrite this note.
properties.basis: North to Dongola through the Abdallab vassals: Holt & Daly (intro p.8) put 'the vassal-kingdom of Dongola' on the route to the frontier-post of Mushu, south of the Third Cataract; MSM1972 p.151 reports the Abdallab sway 'from Arbaji to the Third Cataract', and p.279 calls Dongola the capital 'of one of the important provinces subject to them'. Kordofan rivalry with Darfur: GHA V p.187. Claimed zone, EDITORIAL.
